derivation: from a compound of G3641 (ὀλίγος) and ("care");
def: to have little regard for, i.e. to disesteem

occurrences.text: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
